question: 列出2024 年 3 月工作日按日期分组的前 3 个分组及其平均停留时长（一位小数）
sql: SELECT f.dt AS dim_val, ROUND(AVG(f.duration_sec), 1) AS metric_val FROM fact_visit f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.is_workday = 1 AND d.month = 3 AND d.year = 2024 AND f.duration_sec BETWEEN 10 AND 300 GROUP BY f.dt ORDER BY dim_val LIMIT 3;

question: 同时统计2024 年上半年的金额与件数乘积之和、成交金额与订单数

question: 给出2024 年第一季度按用户城市分组的平均停留时长及其下一行的值
sql: SELECT dim_val, metric_val, LEAD(metric_val, 1) OVER (ORDER BY dim_val) AS w_val FROM (SELECT u.city AS dim_val, AVG(f.duration_sec) AS metric_val FROM fact_visit f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key JOIN dim_user u ON f.user_id = u.user_id WHERE d.quarter = 1 AND d.year = 2024 AND f.page LIKE 'h%' GROUP BY u.city) t ORDER BY dim_val;

question: 给出2024 年 3 月按月份分组的平均订单金额及其按指标从高到低的连续排名
sql: SELECT dim_val, metric_val, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY metric_val DESC) AS w_val FROM (SELECT d.month AS dim_val, AVG(f.amount) AS metric_val FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.month = 3 AND d.year = 2024 AND COALESCE(f.qty, 0) > 1 GROUP BY d.month) t ORDER BY dim_val;

question: 列出2024 年 3 月按订单状态分组的前 3 个分组及其金额与件数乘积之和

question: 基于2024 年上半年按用户城市分组的平均停留时长结果再求COUNT值
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS agg_val FROM (SELECT u.city AS dim_val, AVG(f.duration_sec) AS metric_val FROM fact_visit f JOIN dim_user u ON f.user_id = u.user_id WHERE f.date_key BETWEEN 20240101 AND 20240630 AND f.duration_sec > 60 GROUP BY u.city) t;

question: 给出2024 年第一季度按日期分组的最大单笔金额及其按指标从高到低的排名
sql: SELECT dim_val, metric_val, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY metric_val DESC) AS w_val FROM (SELECT f.dt AS dim_val, MAX(f.amount) AS metric_val FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.quarter = 1 AND d.year = 2024 AND f.qty >= 2 GROUP BY f.dt) t ORDER BY dim_val;

question: 找出2024 年 3 月按订单状态分组后平均订单金额（两位小数）超过 100 的分组
sql: SELECT f.status AS dim_val, ROUND(AVG(f.amount), 2) AS metric_val FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.month = 3 AND d.year = 2024 AND f.amount > 100 GROUP BY f.status HAVING ROUND(AVG(f.amount), 2) > 100 ORDER BY metric_val DESC;

question: 给出2024 年 3 月上半月按用户分组的最大单笔支付额及其整体平均值
sql: SELECT dim_val, metric_val, AVG(metric_val) OVER () AS w_val FROM (SELECT f.user_id AS dim_val, MAX(f.pay_amount) AS metric_val FROM fact_pay f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.day <= 15 AND d.month = 3 AND d.year = 2024 AND f.pay_amount BETWEEN 50 AND 500 GROUP BY f.user_id) t ORDER BY dim_val;

question: 列出2024 年第二季度按品牌分组的前 5 个分组及其订单数

question: 基于2024 年 3 月上半月按用户城市分组的平均停留时长（一位小数）结果再求MIN值

question: 列出2024 年 3 月按月份分组的前 3 个分组及其平均支付金额

question: 找出2024 年第二季度按VIP 等级分组后平均停留时长（一位小数）为正的分组
sql: WITH t AS (SELECT u.vip_level AS dim_val, ROUND(AVG(f.duration_sec), 1) AS metric_val FROM fact_visit f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key JOIN dim_user u ON f.user_id = u.user_id WHERE d.quarter = 2 AND d.year = 2024 AND f.page = 'home' GROUP BY u.vip_level) SELECT dim_val, metric_val FROM t WHERE metric_val > 0 ORDER BY dim_val;

question: 找出2024 年 3 月按是否工作日分组后最大单笔金额为正的分组

question: 找出2024 年 3 月按用户城市分组后最小单笔支付额为正的分组

question: 给出2024 年上半年按品牌分组的下单用户数及其按顺序的累计值

question: 统计2024 年 3 月三的倍数编号用户的支付用户数
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.user_id) AS uv FROM fact_pay f  WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', f.dt) = '2024-03' AND f.user_id % 3 = 0;

question: 找出2024 年 3 月按是否工作日分组后平均支付金额超过 100 的分组
sql: SELECT d.is_workday AS dim_val, AVG(f.pay_amount) AS metric_val FROM fact_pay f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE f.dt >= '2024-03-01' AND f.dt < '2024-04-01' AND f.pay_amount BETWEEN 50 AND 500 GROUP BY d.is_workday HAVING AVG(f.pay_amount) > 100 ORDER BY metric_val DESC;

question: 统计2024 年 3 月按周分组的平均停留时长，并依结果从高到低排序
sql: SELECT d.week_of_year AS dim_val, AVG(f.duration_sec) AS metric_val FROM fact_visit f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', f.dt) = '2024-03' AND f.page = 'home' GROUP BY d.week_of_year ORDER BY metric_val DESC;

question: 统计2024 年 3 月按周分组的最短单次停留，并依结果从高到低排序

question: 给出2024 年 3 月按是否工作日分组的金额与件数乘积之和及其按指标从高到低的序号
sql: SELECT dim_val, metric_val, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY metric_val DESC) AS w_val FROM (SELECT d.is_workday AS dim_val, SUM(f.amount * f.qty) AS metric_val FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.week_of_year BETWEEN 9 AND 13 AND d.year = 2024 AND f.status = 'PAID' GROUP BY d.is_workday) t ORDER BY dim_val;

question: 列出2024 年 3 月按支付状态分组的前 10 个分组及其净支付额（两位小数）

sql: SELECT dim_val, metric_val, SUM(metric_val) OVER (ORDER BY dim_val) AS w_val FROM (SELECT d.month AS dim_val, COUNT(DISTINCT f.page) AS metric_val FROM fact_visit f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.day <= 15 AND d.month = 3 AND d.year = 2024 AND f.duration_sec BETWEEN 10 AND 300 GROUP BY d.month) t ORDER BY dim_val;

question: 统计2024 年上半年上海用户产生的2024 年上半年奇数编号用户的最短单次停留
sql: SELECT MIN(f.duration_sec) AS mn_dur FROM fact_visit f  WHERE f.date_key BETWEEN 20240101 AND 20240630 AND f.user_id % 2 = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_user u WHERE u.user_id = f.user_id AND u.city = '上海');

question: 找出2024 年 3 月按用户城市分组后最短单次停留为正的分组
sql: WITH t AS (SELECT u.city AS dim_val, MIN(f.duration_sec) AS metric_val FROM fact_visit f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key JOIN dim_user u ON f.user_id = u.user_id WHERE d.week_of_year BETWEEN 9 AND 13 AND d.year = 2024 GROUP BY u.city) SELECT dim_val, metric_val FROM t WHERE metric_val > 0 ORDER BY dim_val;

question: 列出2024 年 3 月上半月按页面分组的前 5 个分组及其总停留时长
sql: SELECT f.page AS dim_val, SUM(f.duration_sec) AS metric_val FROM fact_visit f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.day <= 15 AND d.month = 3 AND d.year = 2024 AND f.user_id % 2 = 1 GROUP BY f.page ORDER BY dim_val LIMIT 5;

question: 列出2024 年上半年出现过的购买件数取值

question: 给出2024 年第一季度按季度分组的下单用户数及其组内最小值
sql: SELECT dim_val, metric_val, MIN(metric_val) OVER (PARTITION BY dim_val) AS w_val FROM (SELECT d.quarter AS dim_val, COUNT(DISTINCT f.user_id) AS metric_val FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.quarter = 1 AND d.year = 2024 AND f.status = 'PAID' GROUP BY d.quarter) t ORDER BY dim_val;

question: 统计2024 年 3 月高等级会员产生的2024 年 3 月有关联订单的关联订单数

question: 统计2024 年 3 月按用户城市分组的净支付额（两位小数），并依结果从高到低排序
sql: SELECT u.city AS dim_val, ROUND(SUM(f.pay_amount), 2) AS metric_val FROM fact_pay f JOIN dim_user u ON f.user_id = u.user_id WHERE substr(CAST(f.date_key AS TEXT), 1, 6) = '202403' AND f.order_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY metric_val DESC;

question: 统计2024 年第一季度按商品品类分组的金额与件数乘积之和，并依结果从高到低排序
sql: SELECT p.category AS dim_val, SUM(f.amount * f.qty) AS metric_val FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id WHERE d.quarter = 1 AND d.year = 2024 AND f.status = 'PAID' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY metric_val DESC;

question: 列出2024 年上半年关联订单号最大的 10 条记录

question: 列出2024 年 3 月按用户分组的前 3 个分组及其访问次数

question: 统计2024 年 3 月3 月创建的金额与件数乘积之和

question: 找出2024 年上半年按是否工作日分组后最短单次停留超过 100 的分组

question: 找出2024 年 3 月按注册渠道分组后访问次数为正的分组
